supported.query: MATCH (n {node_id: $node_id})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(m) RETURN m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
variants: match (seed {node_id:$node_id})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(endpoint) return endpoint.node_id as node_id order by node_id asc
/* formatting */ MATCH (a {node_id: $node_id}) -[:DEPENDS_ON]-> (b) RETURN b.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id

supported.query: MATCH (n {node_id: $node_id})<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(m) RETURN m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
variants: match (seed {node_id:$node_id})<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(endpoint) return endpoint.node_id as node_id order by node_id asc

supported.query: MATCH (n {node_id: $node_id})<-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..2]-(m) RETURN DISTINCT m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
variants: match (seed {node_id:$node_id})<-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..2]-(endpoint) return distinct endpoint.node_id as node_id order by node_id asc

rejected.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n {node_id: $node_id})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(m) RETURN m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
MATCH (n {node_id: $node_id})-[:KNOWS]->(m) RETURN m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
MATCH (n {node_id: $node_id})-[:DEPENDS_ON*]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
MATCH (n {node_id: $node_id})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(m) RETURN m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id DESC
